001package org.clafer.domain;
002
003import gnu.trove.TIntCollection;
004import gnu.trove.iterator.TIntIterator;
005import gnu.trove.set.TIntSet;
006import gnu.trove.set.hash.TIntHashSet;
007import java.util.Arrays;
008import java.util.PrimitiveIterator;
009import java.util.Spliterator;
010import java.util.Spliterators;
011import java.util.function.IntConsumer;
012import java.util.function.IntPredicate;
013import java.util.stream.IntStream;
014import java.util.stream.StreamSupport;
015import org.clafer.common.Util;
016import org.clafer.ir.IrException;
017
018/**
019 * Immutable domain over integers. Internally stored as a list of (low, high)
020 * disjoint pairs of regions.
021 *
022 *
023 * @author jimmy
024 */
025public class Domain {
026
027    public static final Domain EmptyDomain = new Domain();
028
029    protected final int[] bounds;
030
031    /**
032     * @param bounds sorted, unique, and immutable integers
033     */
034    protected Domain(int... bounds) {
035        if (bounds.length % 2 == 1) {
036            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
037        }
038        assert isStrictSorted(bounds);
039        this.bounds = bounds;
040    }
041
042    private static boolean isStrictSorted(int[] bounds) {
043        for (int i = 1; i < bounds.length; i++) {
044            if (bounds[i - 1] >= bounds[i]) {
045                return false;
046            }
047        }
048        return true;
049    }
050
051    public static Domain boundDomain(int low, int high) {
052        return new Domain(low, high + 1);
053    }
054
055    public static Domain constantDomain(int value) {
056        return boundDomain(value, value);
057    }
058
059    public static Domain enumDomain(int... values) {
060        if (values.length == 1) {
061            return constantDomain(values[0]);
062        }
063        return enumDomain(new TIntHashSet(values));
064    }
065
066    public static Domain enumDomain(TIntSet values) {
067        int[] bounds = new int[2 * values.size()];
068        int regions = 0;
069        int[] array = values.toArray();
070        Arrays.sort(array);
071        int i = 0;
072        while (i < array.length) {
073            int prev = i;
074            do {
075                i++;
076            } while (i < array.length && array[i] == array[i - 1] + 1);
077            bounds[regions++] = array[prev];
078            bounds[regions++] = array[i - 1] + 1;
079        }
080        if (regions < bounds.length) {
081            return new Domain(Arrays.copyOf(bounds, regions));
082        }
083        return new Domain(bounds);
084    }
085
086    public static Domain enumDomain(IntStream values) {
087        PrimitiveIterator.OfInt iter = values.sorted().iterator();
088        if (!iter.hasNext()) {
089            return EmptyDomain;
090        }
091        int[] bounds = new int[16];
092        int regions = 0;
093        int start = iter.nextInt();
094        int end = start;
095        while (iter.hasNext()) {
096            int i = iter.nextInt();
097            if (i == end + 1) {
098                end = i;
099            } else {
100                if (regions == bounds.length) {
101                    bounds = Arrays.copyOf(bounds, 2 * bounds.length);
102                }
103                bounds[regions++] = start;
104                bounds[regions++] = end + 1;
105                start = i;
106                end = start;
107            }
108        }
109        if (regions == bounds.length) {
110            bounds = Arrays.copyOf(bounds, 2 + bounds.length);
111        }
112        bounds[regions++] = start;
113        bounds[regions++] = end + 1;
114        if (regions < bounds.length) {
115            return new Domain(Arrays.copyOf(bounds, regions));
116        }
117        return new Domain(bounds);
118    }
119
120    /**
121     * Checks if this domain is defined as a lower and upper bound. If the
122     * domain is bounded then it contains every value between its lower and
123     * upper bound.
124     *
125     * @return {@code true} if and only if this domain is a single contiguous
126     * region, {@code false} otherwise
127     */
128    public boolean isBounded() {
129        return bounds.length <= 2;
130    }
131
132    /**
133     * Checks if a value is within this domain.
134     *
135     * @param value test this value
136     * @return {@code true} if and only if this domain contains the
137     * {@code value}, {@code false} otherwise
138     */
139    public boolean contains(int value) {
140        return Util.ordinal(value, bounds) % 2 == 1;
141    }
142
143    public boolean containsAll(TIntCollection values) {
144        TIntIterator iter = values.iterator();
145        while (iter.hasNext()) {
146            if (!contains(iter.next())) {
147                return false;
148            }
149        }
150        return true;
151    }
152
153    public boolean containsAll(int[] values) {
154        for (int value : values) {
155            if (!contains(value)) {
156                return false;
157            }
158        }
159        return true;
160    }
161
162    public boolean containsAll(int low, int high) {
163        int lowOrdinal = Util.ordinal(low, bounds);
164        if (lowOrdinal % 2 == 0) {
165            return false;
166        }
167        if (low == high) {
168            return true;
169        }
170        int highOrdinal = Util.ordinal(high, bounds);
171        return lowOrdinal == highOrdinal;
172    }
173
174    public boolean containsAny(TIntCollection values) {
175        TIntIterator iter = values.iterator();
176        while (iter.hasNext()) {
177            if (contains(iter.next())) {
178                return true;
179            }
180        }
181        return false;
182    }
183
184    public boolean containsAny(int[] values) {
185        for (int value : values) {
186            if (contains(value)) {
187                return true;
188            }
189        }
190        return false;
191    }
192
193    public boolean containsAny(int low, int high) {
194        int lowOrdinal = Util.ordinal(low, bounds);
195        if (lowOrdinal % 2 == 1) {
196            return true;
197        }
198        int highOrdinal = Util.ordinal(high, bounds);
199        return lowOrdinal != highOrdinal;
200    }
201
202    /**
203     * Returns the smallest integer contained in this domain. Undefined if this
204     * domain is empty.
205     *
206     * @return the smallest integer contained in this domain
207     */
208    public int getLowBound() {
209        if (bounds.length == 0) {
210            throw new IrException("Emtpy domain does not have a low bound.");
211        }
212        return bounds[0];
213    }
214
215    /**
216     * Returns the largest integer contained in this domain. Undefined if this
217     * domain is empty.
218     *
219     * @return the largest integer contained in this domain
220     */
221    public int getHighBound() {
222        if (bounds.length == 0) {
223            throw new IrException("Emtpy domain does not have a low bound.");
224        }
225        return bounds[bounds.length - 1] - 1;
226    }
227
228    /**
229     * Checks if this domain contains no values.
230     *
231     * @return {@code true} if and only if the size of this domain is zero,
232     * {@code false} otherwise
233     */
234    public boolean isEmpty() {
235        return bounds.length == 0;
236    }
237
238    /**
239     * Checks if this domain contains a single value.
240     *
241     * @return {@code true} if and only if the size of this domain is one,
242     * {@code false} otherwise
243     */
244    public boolean isConstant() {
245        return bounds.length == 2 && bounds[0] + 1 == bounds[1];
246    }
247
248    /**
249     * Returns how many values are contained in this domain.
250     *
251     * @return the size of this domain
252     */
253    public int size() {
254        int size = 0;
255        for (int i = 0; i < bounds.length; i += 2) {
256            size += bounds[i + 1] - bounds[i];
257        }
258        return size;
259    }
260
261    /**
262     * Check if this domain is a (non-strict) subset of another domain.
263     *
264     * @param superset
265     * @return {@code true} if and only if this domain is a subset of
266     * {@code superset}, {@code false} otherwise
267     */
268    public boolean isSubsetOf(Domain superset) {
269        if (this == superset) {
270            return true;
271        }
272        for (int i = 0; i < bounds.length; i += 2) {
273            if (!superset.containsAll(bounds[i], bounds[i + 1] - 1)) {
274                return false;
275            }
276        }
277        return true;
278    }
279
280    public boolean isSupersetOf(Domain subset) {
281        return subset.isSubsetOf(this);
282    }
283
284    /**
285     * Check if this domain intersects another domain.
286     *
287     * @param other
288     * @return {@code true} if and only if this domain is intersects
289     * {@code other}, {@code false} otherwise
290     */
291    public boolean intersects(Domain other) {
292        if (this == other && !isEmpty()) {
293            return true;
294        }
295        for (int i = 0; i < bounds.length; i += 2) {
296            if (other.containsAny(bounds[i], bounds[i + 1] - 1)) {
297                return true;
298            }
299        }
300        return false;
301    }
302
303    private Domain insertOrRemove(boolean insertOrRemove, int value) {
304        int ordinal = Util.ordinal(value, bounds);
305        if (ordinal % 2 == (insertOrRemove ? 1 : 0)) {
306            return this;
307        }
308        if (ordinal > 0 && bounds[ordinal - 1] == value) {
309            if (ordinal < bounds.length && bounds[ordinal] == value + 1) {
310                // Merge the two regions.
311                int[] newBounds = new int[bounds.length - 2];
312                System.arraycopy(bounds, 0, newBounds, 0, ordinal - 1);
313                System.arraycopy(bounds, ordinal + 1, newBounds, ordinal - 1, bounds.length - ordinal - 1);
314                return new Domain(newBounds);
315            }
316            int[] newBounds = bounds.clone();
317            newBounds[ordinal - 1]++;
318            return new Domain(newBounds);
319        } else if (ordinal < bounds.length && bounds[ordinal] == value + 1) {
320            int[] newBounds = bounds.clone();
321            newBounds[ordinal]--;
322            return new Domain(newBounds);
323        } else {
324            int[] newBounds = new int[bounds.length + 2];
325            System.arraycopy(bounds, 0, newBounds, 0, ordinal);
326            newBounds[ordinal] = value;
327            newBounds[ordinal + 1] = value + 1;
328            System.arraycopy(bounds, ordinal, newBounds, ordinal + 2, bounds.length - ordinal);
329            return new Domain(newBounds);
330        }
331    }
332
333    /**
334     * Add an element into this domain.
335     *
336     * @param value
337     * @return {@code this.union({value})}
338     */
339    public Domain insert(int value) {
340        return insertOrRemove(true, value);
341    }
342
343    /**
344     * Remove an element from this domain.
345     *
346     * @param value
347     * @return {@code this.difference({value})}
348     */
349    public Domain remove(int value) {
350        return insertOrRemove(false, value);
351    }
352
353    /**
354     * Remove all elements from this domain where the predicate evaluates to
355     * {@code true}.
356     *
357     * @param predicate
358     * @return a subset of this domain where the predicate evaluates to
359     * {@code false}.
360     */
361    public Domain removeAll(IntPredicate predicate) {
362        Domain remove = this;
363        for (int region = 0; region < bounds.length; region += 2) {
364            for (int i = bounds[region]; i < bounds[region + 1]; i++) {
365                if (predicate.test(i)) {
366                    remove = remove.remove(i);
367                }
368            }
369        }
370        return remove;
371    }
372
373    /**
374     * Retains all elements from this domain where the predicate evaluates to
375     * {@code true}.
376     *
377     * @param predicate
378     * @return a subset of this domain where the predicate evaluates to
379     * {@code true}.
380     */
381    public Domain retainAll(IntPredicate predicate) {
382        return removeAll(predicate.negate());
383    }
384
385    /**
386     * Remove all elements less than the bound from this domain.
387     *
388     * @param low
389     * @return {@code this.intersection({low, low + 1, ...})}
390     */
391    public Domain boundLow(int low) {
392        if (isEmpty() || low <= getLowBound()) {
393            return this;
394        }
395        int ordinal = Util.ordinal(low, bounds);
396        if (ordinal % 2 == 0) {
397            int[] newBounds = Arrays.copyOfRange(bounds, ordinal, bounds.length);
398            return new Domain(newBounds);
399        }
400        int[] newBounds = Arrays.copyOfRange(bounds, ordinal - 1, bounds.length);
401        newBounds[0] = low;
402        return new Domain(newBounds);
403    }
404
405    /**
406     * Remove all elements greater than the bound from this domain.
407     *
408     * @param high
409     * @return {@code this.intersection({high, high - 1, ...})}
410     */
411    public Domain boundHigh(int high) {
412        if (isEmpty() || high >= getHighBound()) {
413            return this;
414        }
415        int ordinal = Util.ordinal(high, bounds);
416        if (ordinal % 2 == 0) {
417            int[] newBounds = Arrays.copyOfRange(bounds, 0, ordinal);
418            return new Domain(newBounds);
419        }
420        int[] newBounds = Arrays.copyOfRange(bounds, 0, ordinal + 1);
421        newBounds[ordinal] = high + 1;
422        return new Domain(newBounds);
423    }
424
425    /**
426     * Remove all elements less than the low bound or greater than the high
427     * bound from this domain.
428     *
429     * @param low
430     * @param high
431     * @return {@code this.intersection({low, low + 1, ..., high})
432     */
433    public Domain boundBetween(int low, int high) {
434        return boundLow(low).boundHigh(high);
435    }
436
437    public Domain minus() {
438        int[] newBounds = new int[bounds.length];
439        for (int i = 0; i < newBounds.length; i++) {
440            newBounds[i] = -bounds[bounds.length - i - 1] + 1;
441        }
442        return new Domain(newBounds);
443    }
444
445    /**
446     * Subtract this domain with the other domain.
447     *
448     * @param other
449     * @return the difference of this domain with the other domain
450     */
451    public Domain difference(Domain other) {
452        if (isEmpty() || !intersects(other)) {
453            return this;
454        }
455        int[] newBounds = new int[bounds.length + other.bounds.length];
456        int length = 0;
457        int i = 0;
458        int j = 0;
459
460        int from = bounds[i];
461        int to = bounds[i + 1];
462
463        while (true) {
464            while (j < other.bounds.length
465                    && from >= other.bounds[j + 1]) {
466                j += 2;
467            }
468            if (j == other.bounds.length
469                    || to <= other.bounds[j]) {
470                newBounds[length++] = from;
471                newBounds[length++] = to;
472                from = to;
473            } else if (from < other.bounds[j]
474                    && to > other.bounds[j]) {
475                newBounds[length++] = from;
476                newBounds[length++] = other.bounds[j];
477                from = other.bounds[j + 1];
478            } else {
479                from = other.bounds[j + 1];
480            }
481            if (from >= to) {
482                i += 2;
483                if (i >= bounds.length) {
484                    break;
485                }
486                from = bounds[i];
487                to = bounds[i + 1];
488            }
489        }
490        if (length == newBounds.length) {
491            return new Domain(newBounds);
492        }
493        return new Domain(Arrays.copyOf(newBounds, length));
494    }
495
496    /**
497     * Intersect this domain with the other domain.
498     *
499     * @param other
500     * @return the intersection of this domain with the other domain
501     */
502    public Domain intersection(Domain other) {
503        if (isSubsetOf(other)) {
504            return this;
505        }
506        if (other.isSubsetOf(this)) {
507            return other;
508        }
509        int[] newBounds = new int[bounds.length + other.bounds.length];
510        int length = 0;
511        int i = 0;
512        int j = 0;
513
514        int from = bounds[i];
515        int to = bounds[i + 1];
516
517        while (true) {
518            while (j < other.bounds.length
519                    && from >= other.bounds[j + 1]) {
520                j += 2;
521            }
522            if (j == other.bounds.length
523                    || to <= other.bounds[j]) {
524                from = to;
525            } else if (from >= other.bounds[j]
526                    && to <= other.bounds[j + 1]) {
527                newBounds[length++] = from;
528                newBounds[length++] = to;
529                from = to;
530            } else {
531                newBounds[length++] = Math.max(from, other.bounds[j]);
532                newBounds[length++] = Math.min(to, other.bounds[j + 1]);
533                from = newBounds[length - 1];
534            }
535            if (from >= to) {
536                i += 2;
537                if (i >= bounds.length) {
538                    break;
539                }
540                from = bounds[i];
541                to = bounds[i + 1];
542            }
543        }
544        if (length == newBounds.length) {
545            return new Domain(newBounds);
546        }
547        return new Domain(Arrays.copyOf(newBounds, length));
548    }
549
550    private static int[] mergeRegions(int[] bounds) {
551        int length = 0;
552        int head = 0;
553        while (head < bounds.length) {
554            int from = bounds[head];
555            int to = bounds[head + 1];
556            while (head < bounds.length - 2
557                    && to >= bounds[head + 2]) {
558                head += 2;
559                to = Math.max(to, bounds[head + 1]);
560            }
561            bounds[length++] = from;
562            bounds[length++] = to;
563            head += 2;
564        }
565        if (length == bounds.length) {
566            return bounds;
567        }
568        return Arrays.copyOf(bounds, length);
569    }
570
571    /**
572     * Union this domain with the other domain.
573     *
574     * @param other
575     * @return the union of this domain with the other domain
576     */
577    public Domain union(Domain other) {
578        if (other.isSubsetOf(this)) {
579            return this;
580        }
581        if (isSubsetOf(other)) {
582            return other;
583        }
584        int[] newBounds = new int[bounds.length + other.bounds.length];
585        int length = 0;
586        int j = 0;
587
588        for (int i = 0; i < bounds.length; i += 2) {
589            while (j < other.bounds.length
590                    && bounds[i] >= other.bounds[j]) {
591                newBounds[length++] = other.bounds[j];
592                newBounds[length++] = other.bounds[j + 1];
593                j += 2;
594            }
595            newBounds[length++] = bounds[i];
596            newBounds[length++] = bounds[i + 1];
597        }
598        while (j < other.bounds.length) {
599            newBounds[length++] = other.bounds[j];
600            newBounds[length++] = other.bounds[j + 1];
601            j += 2;
602        }
603        return new Domain(mergeRegions(newBounds));
604    }
605
606    /**
607     * Shift the elements in this domain.
608     *
609     * @param c
610     * @return the shifted domain
611     */
612    public Domain offset(int c) {
613        if (c == 0) {
614            return this;
615        }
616        int[] newBounds = new int[bounds.length];
617        for (int i = 0; i < newBounds.length; i++) {
618            newBounds[i] = bounds[i] + c;
619        }
620        return new Domain(newBounds);
621    }
622
623    public Domain add(Domain other) {
624        if (isEmpty()) {
625            return this;
626        }
627        if (other.isEmpty()) {
628            return other;
629        }
630        if (isConstant()) {
631            return other.offset(getLowBound());
632        }
633        if (other.isConstant()) {
634            return offset(other.getLowBound());
635        }
636        Domain sum = null;
637        for (int i = 0; i < bounds.length; i += 2) {
638            int[] newBounds = new int[other.bounds.length];
639            for (int j = 0; j < other.bounds.length; j += 2) {
640                newBounds[j] = bounds[i] + other.bounds[j];
641                newBounds[j + 1] = bounds[i + 1] + other.bounds[j + 1] - 1;
642            }
643            Domain domain = new Domain(mergeRegions(newBounds));
644            sum = sum == null ? domain : sum.union(domain);
645        }
646        return sum;
647    }
648
649    /**
650     * Returns all the values contained in this domain.
651     *
652     * @return values contained in this domain
653     */
654    public int[] getValues() {
655        int[] values = new int[size()];
656        int size = 0;
657        for (int region = 0; region < bounds.length; region += 2) {
658            for (int i = bounds[region]; i < bounds[region + 1]; i++) {
659                values[size++] = i;
660            }
661        }
662        assert size == values.length;
663        return values;
664    }
665
666    /**
667     * Perform the action for every value in this domain in increasing order.
668     *
669     * @param action the action to perform
670     */
671    public void forEach(IntConsumer action) {
672        for (int region = 0; region < bounds.length; region += 2) {
673            for (int i = bounds[region]; i < bounds[region + 1]; i++) {
674                action.accept(i);
675            }
676        }
677    }
678
679    /**
680     * Iterate over the domain in increasing order.
681     *
682     * @return an iterator over the values in this domain in increasing order
683     */
684    public PrimitiveIterator.OfInt iterator() {
685        return new ForwardIterator();
686    }
687
688    /**
689     * Iterate over the domain in the specified order.
690     *
691     * @param increasing increasing or decreasing order
692     * @return an iterator over the values in this domain in the order specified
693     */
694    public PrimitiveIterator.OfInt iterator(boolean increasing) {
695        return increasing ? new ForwardIterator() : new ReverseIterator();
696    }
697
698    public IntStream stream() {
699        Spliterator.OfInt spliterator = Spliterators.spliterator(
700                iterator(), size(),
701                Spliterator.DISTINCT | Spliterator.IMMUTABLE
702                | Spliterator.ORDERED | Spliterator.SORTED | Spliterator.SIZED);
703        return StreamSupport.intStream(spliterator, false);
704    }
705
706    @Override
707    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
708        if (obj instanceof Domain) {
709            Domain other = (Domain) obj;
710            return Arrays.equals(bounds, other.bounds);
711        }
712        return false;
713    }
714
715    @Override
716    public int hashCode() {
717        return Arrays.hashCode(bounds);
718    }
719
720    @Override
721    public String toString() {
722        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
723        result.append('{');
724        for (int i = 0; i < bounds.length; i += 2) {
725            if (i > 0) {
726                result.append(", ");
727            }
728            if (bounds[i + 1] > bounds[i] + 2) {
729                result.append(bounds[i]);
730                result.append("...");
731                result.append(bounds[i + 1] - 1);
732            } else {
733                for (int j = bounds[i]; j < bounds[i + 1]; j++) {
734                    if (j > bounds[i]) {
735                        result.append(", ");
736                    }
737                    result.append(j);
738                }
739            }
740        }
741        result.append('}');
742        return result.toString();
743    }
744
745    private class ForwardIterator implements PrimitiveIterator.OfInt {
746
747        int region = 0;
748        int i = 0;
749
750        @Override
751        public int nextInt() {
752            int next = bounds[region] + i;
753            if (next == bounds[region + 1] - 1) {
754                region += 2;
755                i = 0;
756            } else {
757                i++;
758            }
759            return next;
760        }
761
762        @Override
763        public boolean hasNext() {
764            return region < bounds.length;
765        }
766
767        @Override
768        public void remove() {
769            throw new UnsupportedOperationException();
770        }
771    }
772
773    private class ReverseIterator implements PrimitiveIterator.OfInt {
774
775        int region = bounds.length - 2;
776        int i = 1;
777
778        @Override
779        public int nextInt() {
780            int next = bounds[region + 1] - i;
781            if (next == bounds[region]) {
782                region -= 2;
783                i = 1;
784            } else {
785                i++;
786            }
787            return next;
788        }
789
790        @Override
791        public boolean hasNext() {
792            return region >= 0;
793        }
794
795        @Override
796        public void remove() {
797            throw new UnsupportedOperationException();
798        }
799    }
800}
